metadata.description: Ticket-to-PR development workflow skills with pluggable issue trackers.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Nine skills covering the path from a ticket to a pull request: triage-task, plan-change, implement-change, review-diff, write-commit, draft-pr, address-review, plus frame-product and trace-incident for work that starts without a ticket. Scripts distil tracker payloads and enforce policy; prompts stay short.
